title: Pavements look like brick walls; paths should read as roads/walkways that connect
details: (Owner, in chat, 2026-09-26) "THE MAP PAVEMENTS AREN'T THE BEST, THEY LOOK LIKE BRICK WALLS, SO RATHER CHANGE TO ROAD OR SOMETHING LIKE THAT, SOMETHING MORE INTUITIVE AND IT CONNECTS".
